name: canvas-app-frontend
buildCommand: if [ -d frontend ]; then cd frontend; fi && npm run build
installCommand: if [ -d frontend ]; then cd frontend; fi && npm install
devCommand: if [ -d frontend ]; then cd frontend; fi && npm start

headers.value: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://*/; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; frame-ancestors 'none';
